links.when: CROP Walk Supporters Thank you to all of those who have walked or donated to the 2026 CROP Walk!
links.title: Donations will be accepted through November 30th. We walk and raise funds together to provide meals for those in our own community who need them - and support programs that create greater food security in communities all around the world.  We will be accepting donations for the CROP walk through November 30th. Checks can be made out to CWS/CROP and dropped off in Jessica Fry’s mailbox at the Church office, or mail to CCGR at 354 Rock Rd, Glen Rock NJ 07452.
